locations.notes: Route 1 is now only the road from your house to Iki Town. The beach and school are now officially labelled as different areas, so check your Pokemon's caught locations. | Scatterbug and Spewpa caught here evolve into Ocean Pattern Vivillon. OOOOSNDSDSODN

battles.notes: This Yungoos appears the first time you enter grass. It is not capturable, as you shouldn't have Pokeballs yet.

This Rattata is guaranteed to be your first capturable encounter here. If you are Nuzlocking, I highly recommend either skipping this Rattata, or counting it as a bonus/gift encounter, as otherwise you will always have this as your first Pokemon.
